answer_1.quote: Open Information Extraction (OpenIE) aims to generate structured tuples from unstructured open-domain text.
answer_1.outputs: structured tuples in the form of ⟨Subject, Relation, Object⟩ or ⟨ARG0, Relation, ARG1, ..., ARGn⟩

answer_2.quote: Both scoring functions report F1 score based on precision and recall computed by tuples matching. Each tuple extracted is associated with a confidence value, so we can generate a precision-recall (P-R) curve and report the area under P-R curve (AUC).
